name: Justin Kyle Stang
locations: South Whitehall Township, Lehigh County, Pennsylvania
sources: Obituary of Justin Kyle Stang, Morning Call, Allentown, Feb 2004 (Legacy.com)
notes: Died 7 Feb 2004, aged 18, in a car accident in South Whitehall Township. A senior at Parkland High School, where he played varsity soccer and belonged to the National Honor Society and Spanish Club; a member of St Joseph the Worker Church, Orefield.
